resources.string:
A New Foundation

Sky Map has been rebuilt from the ground up with a modern rendering and data pipeline and a refreshed UI.

A Sharper Solar System

The Sun, Moon and planets have been redrawn from their original NASA imagery, and pictures across the map are now smoothed and blended so they hold up at every zoom level. Planets can also be drawn at their true angular size — pick glyphs or true scale in the Layers sheet.

A Moon That Matches the Sky

The Moon\'s phase is now worked out from its real geometry instead of chosen from eight fixed pictures, so the line between light and dark falls where you actually see it.

Better Sun and Moon Positions

More accurate Sun and Moon calculations put both bodies where they belong and fix the timing of eclipses.

Smoother Panning

Fixed a stutter that showed up when flinging or dragging the map on high refresh-rate screens — panning, momentum and the search zoom now track your display\'s actual frame rate instead of a fixed rate.

A Fresher Welcome

The background on the very first screen you see has been refreshed with a new in-app capture of the sky.

Sky Notifications

Turn on optional notifications for meteor shower peaks and a one-time evening digest of what\'s visible tonight, right from Settings.

Lunar Eclipses

The map now renders the Moon\'s copper-red tint during a lunar eclipse, and the Moon\'s info card, tonight\'s-sky digest and countdown widget all know when one is coming — with an optional reminder notification.

Clearer Permissions

The Terms screen and Help now spell out exactly what each device permission is used for, and the app no longer requests the advertising-ID permission it didn\'t need.

Bonjour!

Sky Map now speaks French, the first translation in the v2 rewrite.

Beta users!

Your help is needed more than ever in reporting bugs and crashes at skymapdevs@gmail.com or GitHub. It is not fully feature-complete yet and (sorry) is not fully translated. If you want to leave the beta and revert to classic Sky Map please visit the testing page.
